utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Hi Ira — are we still on for the repair drive, and what do you need me to bring?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Yep, we’re still on. If you can bring some packing tape and a few boxes, that’d be a big help.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Got it — I’ll bring packing tape and a few boxes.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing — I can lend a hand and bring over a few tools for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, great — thanks, Gus. I might have missed the details, but I’m glad you can bring the tools over.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: No problem — I’ll swing by with the tools and we can sort out the details together.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m a bit nervous about the logistics—do we know exactly where to drop everything off and what time they’re expecting us?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I heard they’re having us drop everything off at the community center parking lot, and they want folks there by 9 in the morning. If I find out anything changes, I’ll pass it along.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure thing — I can help with the repair drive. What do you need me to bring or do?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Sam — could you bring your toolbox and meet me by the community shed? I’ll point you to the first repair spot from there.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely — I’ll bring my toolbox and meet you by the community shed.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: I heard about the repair drive—sounds like a great neighborhood effort. Want me to pass along the invite and help get a few more folks there?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: That’d be kind, Quinn. Thank you — please do.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll spread the word and see who else can come lend a hand.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Leo — I’m getting the repair drive organized and I’d love your help where you can. What feels most urgent on the block right now?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: The broken streetlight by the corner feels most urgent to me. I can help check on it this afternoon.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That’s a big help, Leo — thank you. I’ll note the streetlight as the top priority and check in with you this afternoon.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Before we do anything, can you tell me the exact time and what needs fixing on the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I’m a bit late, so I don’t have the exact time yet. What needs fixing on the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I’m not sure yet either, so let’s check the details first—what parts are acting up on the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help with that—what time does the repair drive start, and do we need to work around school pickup?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: It starts at 3:30, so we should be fine if we wrap the school pickup folks in first. Thanks for helping—I'll keep it organized around that.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Perfect, that works for me. I’ll plan to be there after pickup and help get things moving.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I heard the repair drive is picking up, but I’m still catching up on the details. Did they say what they need help with most?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Mostly hands-on help—sorting donations, minor fixes, and coordinating pickups. I can fill you in on the list if you want.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Yes, please — I’m happy to help, but I need the rundown first.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good—what do you need from me for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, are you asking me to bring my tools or just show up and help?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Just show up and help is fine—no tools needed.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can help out with the repair drive. What still needs doing?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, thanks, Rey — I’m a bit mixed up, but I know we still need folks to sort donations and maybe help with the pickup list. If you’re up for it, that’d be a huge help.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Sure, I can sort donations and help with the pickup list. Just point me to where to start.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’ll help spread the word about the repair drive and keep everyone posted on the plan.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Vik — I’ll keep an eye on the supplies and let you know what we’re short on.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sounds good — I’ll tell the neighbors the plan and update them if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Oh, nice — how’s the repair drive going so far?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: It’s going pretty well so far—slow, but steady. I’m glad people are showing up.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: That’s great to hear—slow and steady still gets it done. I might swing by later and drop something off.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh right, the repair drive — I was just thinking about that. What do you need me to bring?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Could you bring a box of gloves and a few basic tools? I’ll bring the rest and we can sort it out together.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Absolutely — I’ll grab a box of gloves and my tool bag. See you there, and we’ll sort the rest out together.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right — the repair drive. What time were we doing that again?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I think we said 6 PM at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Right, 6 PM at the community center — I’ll try to make it.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing, Eli — I can lend a hand and bring whatever tools you need for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Gus. Let’s keep it simple—just meet me at the curb after breakfast, and we’ll load the tools from there.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds good — I’ll meet you at the curb after breakfast with the tools.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I’m happy to help with the repair drive—what still needs doing?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Amazing — we still need a few volunteers to sort tools, make sign-up calls, and help set up Saturday morning. I can send out the invite list right now.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I can take the sign-up calls and help with Saturday setup. Send me the invite list, and I’ll get started.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’m happy to help with the repair drive—what do you need me to connect or coordinate?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Jules — could you coordinate with the folks on Maple Street and let me know who can drop off tools at the community center?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely — I’ll reach out to the Maple Street folks and gather who can drop off tools at the community center. I’ll let you know as soon as I hear back.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: I’ve got the repair drive list started, and I’m keeping it organized so nothing gets missed. If you want, I can slot you in for a task that fits your schedule.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Rosa — I can take a task, and I’m good with whatever you still need most.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That’s great, Cleo — I still need someone to check in with the folks on Maple Street, and it should only take a quick round. If that works for you, I’ll put your name next to it.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I heard the repair drive is coming together nicely. If you need help spreading the word, I can pass it along.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: That’d help a lot, Nell. Can you tell people we’re still looking for volunteers and tools?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Absolutely — I’ll let folks know you still need volunteers and tools. If I hear anyone who can help, I’ll send them your way.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: I’m in — just give me the basics on the repair drive and where to drop things off.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Great — we’re collecting small appliances, bikes, and hand tools this Saturday from 9 to 12 at the community center. Just bring items to the side lot, and I’ll help direct you where to leave them.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Perfect, thanks — I’ll swing by Saturday morning with whatever I’ve got.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I’m happy to help with the repair drive—what do you need me to do?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Thanks, Sam — can you confirm you’re available this Saturday morning to help?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Yes, I’m available this Saturday morning and I can help with the repair drive.
